# Thinkora

> Thinkora is a free website with an online IQ test, brain games and an IQ percentile calculator. Results are estimates for information and entertainment, not a clinical assessment. No account or email is required.

## Tests and tools
- [Free IQ test](https://abdullah138282.github.io/iq-test/): 38 original questions on spatial, numerical, logical, verbal and applied reasoning, with an estimated IQ, percentile and skill breakdown.
- [IQ percentile calculator](https://abdullah138282.github.io/iq-percentile-calculator/): convert an IQ score to a percentile.
- [IQ score chart](https://abdullah138282.github.io/iq-scores/): score ranges, percentiles and classifications.

## Brain games
- [Brain games overview](https://abdullah138282.github.io/brain-games/)
- [Reaction time test](https://abdullah138282.github.io/reaction-time-test/)
- [Number memory test](https://abdullah138282.github.io/number-memory-test/)
- [Pattern memory game](https://abdullah138282.github.io/pattern-memory-game/)
- [Color difference test](https://abdullah138282.github.io/color-difference-test/)
- [Mental math test](https://abdullah138282.github.io/mental-math-test/)
- [Anagram speed test](https://abdullah138282.github.io/anagram-speed-test/): unscramble words in 60 seconds
- [Vocabulary test](https://abdullah138282.github.io/vocabulary-test/): 20 word-meaning questions at three levels
